# STATE NATIONALIST REFORM

> Strategic operations platform focused on asset protection, jurisdictional
> standing, and constitutional wealth insulation. Delivered as a
> high-performance single-page application with interactive data
> visualization and secure intelligence resources.

STATE NATIONALIST REFORM is a web-based intelligence and operations
platform organized around four operational sectors: Mission, Funding,
Standing, and Vault. The application presents strategic briefings,
asset insulation data visualizations, jurisdictional flow analysis, and
a curated resource grid covering 98-Series protocols. The platform is
built for low-bandwidth operational environments and is fully
mobile-responsive.

## Mission

- [Strategic Briefing](/): Overview of the platform's purpose, hero video, and progress indicators.

## Funding

- [Asset Insulation Visualization](/): Interactive bar charts (Chart.js) illustrating asset insulation data.

## Standing

- [Jurisdictional Flow Diagram](/): Interactive Sankey diagram (Plotly.js) mapping the transition from public liability to private authority.

## Vault

- [98-Series Protocol Resources](/): Intelligence resource grid covering 98-Series protocols and related materials.

## Inquiry

- [Strategic Enquiry Form](/): Secure contact form (Name, Secure Email, Strategic Enquiry). Submissions are delivered via FormSubmit.co.

## Technical

- Stack: Vanilla HTML5 / ES6+ JavaScript, Tailwind CSS (CDN), Chart.js, Plotly.js
- Media: Rumble embed (lazy-loaded)
- Analytics: Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics 4 (G-C2153TK33Z)
- Accessibility: WCAG-aligned — semantic headings, ARIA roles, SR-only labels
- Security: CSRF protection via FormSubmit, honeypot field, rel="noopener" on external links
